test.create_query: CREATE TABLE join_partitions_left (d Date, id UInt64, v UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(d) ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE join_partitions_right (d Date, id UInt64, w UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(d) ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO join_partitions_left SELECT toDate('2022-01-01') + (number % 1461), intDiv(number, 1461), number FROM numbers_mt(40000000) SETTINGS max_partitions_per_insert_block = 100, max_insert_threads = 8

INSERT INTO join_partitions_right SELECT toDate('2022-01-01') + (number % 1461), intDiv(number, 1461) * 4, number FROM numbers_mt(10000000) SETTINGS max_partitions_per_insert_block = 100, max_insert_threads = 8
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(l.v + r.w) FROM join_partitions_left AS l {kind} JOIN join_partitions_right AS r ON l.d = r.d AND l.id = r.id SETTINGS {sharding} FORMAT Null
